name: P15
title: Diabetic Foot Care Pathway
description: The patient undergoes wound specimen collection. If an ulcer is detected, the patient attends a general surgery specialist visit. If signs of infection worsen, the clinical team is alerted and therapeutic intervention is initiated. Otherwise, the patient receives education on home wound care and medication guidelines.
